Template for prompt: Design a user interface mockup for a SaaS and IaaS platform, GeoAI, aimed at the Spanish Armed Forces. The platform provides advanced geospatial data analysis and AI-driven services. The interface should feature a modern, intuitive dashboard with a clean and professional design that reflects the high-tech nature of the services.

The main dashboard should consist of circular cards representing different service categories: Digital Mapping and Modeling, Image Processing and Analysis, Planning and Navigation, Predictive and Strategic Analysis, and Visualization and Simulation.

Design Interaction: When a user hovers over a category card, it should expand and reveal additional smaller circular cards representing the specific microservices within that category.

Template for prompt: Design a login page where the left side features the login form, while the right side showcases engaging content tailored to an e-learning company. This content could include testimonials, offers, or unique elements that highlight our credibility as a trusted and prominent UK-based company. Potential additions might be promotional offers, a loyalty program, trust badges, certifications, or awards, but be cautious not to overcrowd the space.

What elements do you suggest for the right-hand side? It should be minimalistic yet impactful, avoiding direct CTAs to prevent distraction. Instead, aim to energize and excite both new and existing users. The right side should maintain a clean layout with well-aligned elements, featuring a balanced mix of a few interactive features or a couple of standout elements.

Consider highlighting our Trustpilot rating of 4.8 based on 10,000 reviews prominently—70% focus on this, and the remaining 30% on other content. Keep it minimal yet effective.
